name: uberasm-repeating-layer
title: Repeating Layer 3 Vertical Scroll
description:
This UberASM vertically scrolls a layer 3 background in a repeating pattern. Configuration includes autoscroll speed and speed to offset from layer 1.

Compatible with the vanilla status bar. (Unlike naive layer 3 scrolling, the vanilla status bar will not be scrolled into the middle of the screen)
